##### Project general facts

Creek Views 3 by Azizi Developments is a residential tower with an impressive stepped facade, where numerous balconies create a layered, contemporary appearance. A clean white exterior is accentuated by horizontal lines and generous glazing that give the building an elegant, modern look. The tower rises from a ground floor and a three-level podium to nineteen residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy swimming pools, a fully equipped gym and outdoor exercise equipment for an active routine, along with a sports court for team games. Yoga and Zen gardens, a sauna and steam rooms support wellness, while social and barbecue areas, a sun terrace, relaxation zones and an indoor children's play area create welcoming places for families and friends, complemented by a welcoming lobby and lifts serving every floor.

Every apartment features spacious living areas and refined interior finishes in calming tones, with panoramic views of the creek, the city skyline and the lush surrounding landscape. Balconies extend the living space outdoors and fill the interiors with natural light. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Jaddaf and Dubai Healthcare City metro stations are close by. Wafi Mall and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport and the Dubai World Trade Centre are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
